subject.title: improve(ios): guide first-run users into gateway onboarding

question: Should this iOS preview-tour onboarding experience be rebased and adopted on top of current main, narrowed to a smaller preview-only follow-up, or paused because newer onboarding work is now the intended direction?
rationale: The remaining choice is not purely mechanical: this PR adds a new first-run preview/sample mode while current main has since landed overlapping onboarding, routing, security-copy, and typography decisions.

options.title: Rebase and adopt the preview tour
options.body: Keep the feature direction, but require conflict resolution, branded typography, preserved configured-gateway routing, and fresh simulator proof before merge.

options.title: Narrow to a preview-only follow-up
options.body: Extract only the sample workspace or preview-tour pieces maintainers still want and leave setup-code and connection-security behavior to the newer merged paths.

options.title: Pause or close this branch
options.body: Treat current main's onboarding refresh as the maintained direction if the preview-tour product direction is no longer desired.

recommendation.title: Rebase and adopt the preview tour
recommendation.body: Keep the feature direction, but require conflict resolution, branded typography, preserved configured-gateway routing, and fresh simulator proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: The configured-gateway routing work is the clearest current-main ownership signal for the product decision this branch must preserve.
